title: Taking a Taxi
situation: You get into a taxi and tell the driver where to go.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Please stop at that traffic light.

tip: Most Korean taxis take cards, so you can say 카드 돼요 to ask if card payment is okay.

title: Asking Subway Directions
situation: You ask a station worker how to reach your destination by subway.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Excuse me, may I ask something?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I want to go to Gangnam Station.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Do I have to transfer here?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Thank you. That helped a lot.

tip: Look for the line color and number on signs, and follow the arrow to the platform for your direction.

title: Asking for Directions
situation: You stop someone on the street to find a nearby place.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, let me ask for directions.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, what are you looking for?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it is next to that convenience store.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, it is five minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Go straight and it is on the right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, that is right. You will see it soon.

tip: Koreans often point with an open hand rather than one finger, so watch their gesture for the direction.
